text:
Drake Batherson made the week's best headline without touching the puck: asked about the Sidney Crosby trade talk, he told reporters Crosby could have his house if he came to Ottawa. On the ice the week was quieter. He's pointless in four straight, and the chances behind that slump have thinned out too.

His season still looks good on paper, 12 goals and 22 points in 27 games, but the goals are running ahead of the play. He has 12 on 8.2 expected goals (the quality of his chances), shooting 21.1%. He shot 20% last season too, so he's a better finisher than most, but our numbers put his normal closer to 16.6%. Expect fewer of those to go in.

What should keep him useful is the passing. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him 89th percentile among forwards for setting up shots last season, and Evolving-Hockey credited most of his value to the power play. A fourth-round pick who became a top-six regular, he's also a physical one, with 54 hits. Watch his minutes, down to 13:48 against Los Angeles. Our range has him at 25 to 38 goals.
